analysis.executiveSummary: Corgi Loaf Baking Co. executes a textbook championship consolidation move by packaging Saquon Barkley and Cam Skattebo for elite PPR RB1 D'Andre Swift. This transaction elevates Corgi Loaf's active starting-eight C-AVI from 557.0 to 579.8 (+22.8 net gain), securing a locked-in workhorse to pair with Rhamondre Stevenson while sliding David Montgomery into FLEX. For All Hail King Jesus (Retool goal), receiving two starting-caliber RBs erases a glaring void at RB2 and accumulates +78.3 D-AVI in total dynasty asset equity, making acceptance highly likely (94% probability).

visualImpact.explanation: The transaction delivers mutual strategic alignment. Corgi Loaf Baking Co. consolidates two RB pieces into an elite, contract-locked RB1 in D'Andre Swift (81.3 C-AVI), directly improving starting lineup C-AVI by +22.8 points for a championship push. officialAviAnalysis.sideAChampionshipImpact: Corgi Loaf gains +22.8 net starting C-AVI by inserting D'Andre Swift (81.3 C-AVI) into RB1, moving David Montgomery into FLEX, and removing Barkley and Skattebo from the starting eight.
officialAviAnalysis.sideADynastyImpact: Net loss of -78.3 D-AVI (sending 164.9 D-AVI, receiving 86.6 D-AVI), trading long-term equity and 24yo Skattebo for immediate championship starting firepower.
officialAviAnalysis.sideARosterImpact: Tightens RB depth from four startable RBs down to three (Swift, Stevenson, Montgomery), but establishes a top-tier starting backfield duo.
officialAviAnalysis.sideBChampionshipImpact: All Hail King Jesus maintains lineup stability (net starting C-AVI drops by only 3.7 points) while replacing bench-level RB2 Kimani Vidal (27.7 C-AVI) with Cam Skattebo (56.0 C-AVI).
officialAviAnalysis.sideBDynastyImpact: Net gain of +78.3 D-AVI, bolstering multi-year roster value with young lead back Skattebo (81.3 D-AVI) and premier producer Barkley (83.6 D-AVI).
officialAviAnalysis.sideBRosterImpact: Transforms an extremely top-heavy, single-RB roster into a balanced backfield with two proven NFL starters.
officialAviAnalysis.valueAssessment: While side A surrenders higher total asset value on paper (164.9 D-AVI vs 86.6 D-AVI), the trade represents a classic win-now consolidation move where Corgi Loaf trades depth for elite weekly ceiling, perfectly aligned with both franchises' goals.

publicMarketAnalysis.summary: Public consensus views D'Andre Swift as a high-end fantasy RB1/RB2 enjoying multi-year contract security under Ben Johnson in Chicago. Saquon Barkley remains an elite name whose short-term value is slightly depressed by Philadelphia's offense struggles and pitch-count management, though he is fully cleared off the injury report. Cam Skattebo is valued as a promising 24-year-old volume back in New York.
publicMarketAnalysis.aviVsMarket: AVI rates Swift at 81.3 C-AVI / 86.6 D-AVI, closely tracking public market sentiment as a locked-in PPR star. Barkley's C-AVI (49.3) reflects recent managed touches, making this trade an opportunistic buy-high consolidation for Corgi Loaf.
relevantContext: D'Andre Swift is signed through 2029 with $27.5M guaranteed, averaging 19.7 touches and 89.7 yards per game in Chicago's dynamic offense.
Saquon Barkley is officially off Philadelphia's injury report heading into Week 9 and is non-tradeable per NFL reporting, retaining long-term elite RB1 upside.
Cam Skattebo is managing a minor hamstring issue but commands the primary backfield touch share in New York when healthy.
